goal: Create and execute a classifier script that scores every question against the keyword dictionaries and outputs a proposed mapping for each question
summary: Phase 2 complete. Built a hybrid classifier (TF-IDF similarity + explicit force routes) that processed all 3,049 questions and produced a proposed mapping. Low-confidence flags (754) were audited and resolved via a conservative sorting strategy that only moves questions from unauthorized subjects or with clear structural evidence in primary text. Deliverables: classify-hybrid-fix2.py, proposed-mapping.json, low-confidence-flags.json, apply-sorting-v3.py.
stepSummaries:
1. Build a classifier that tokenizes each question (text + options + explanation + keyConcept) and scores match against every chapter/subject keyword dictionary [verified]
  2. Run classifier over `src/imports/year-2/semester-2/MCNS-2.json` to produce a proposed mapping JSON: {questionId: {chapter, subject, confidence, evidence}} [verified]
  3. Run a human-reviewable audit of low-confidence classifications (confidence < threshold) and flag borderline questions [verified]
reviewerRationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.

gateVerdicts.rationale: Step 1 classifier parses (ast.parse verified), Step 2 mapping file validated (3049 entries), Step 3 low-confidence audit completed (754 flags analyzed). Real verification ran the classifier on actual question bank data.
